description: Handles native page file choosers or directly fills a file input/upload component.

pageId.description: Page ID with the pending file chooser.

chooserId.description: Target chooser session id. Required when the page has multiple pending choosers.

accept.description: True to accept the chooser, false to cancel it.

files.description: File paths to submit when accepting the chooser.

id.description: Canonical upload target id. Mutually exclusive with selector.

selector.description: CSS selector for a file input or upload component. Mutually exclusive with id.

purpose.description: Describe your intent for handling this file chooser or upload component, e.g., uploading a document

purposeHint: Describe your intent for handling this file chooser or upload component, e.g., uploading a document
